THE BUSINESS SCHOOL
UNIVERSITY OF JAMMU, BHADERWAH CAMPUS
(A+ Grade University- Accredited by NAAC)
Advertisement Notice
Applications are invited from the candidates as per the eligibility (see below) for one
position of Research Associate in ICSSR Major Research Project entitled “Empowering
Producers and Entrepreneurs through Sustainable Business Models for Local Products-
Agro Based and Essential Oils”. The position will be temporary initially for the period of
one year from the date of appointment which may be extended further as per the
requirement of the project. Interested candidates can apply for the same on prescribed
format (attached). The application should be emailed to sunil.tbsju@gmail.com along
with a hardcopy posted to Dr Sunil Bhardwaj, The Business School, Bhaderwah Campus,
University of Jammu, Bhaderwah, Dist. Doda, JKUT-182222. Last date for receiving the
applications (both in soft and hard) is 15 days from the date of publication of this
advertisement. The scheduled time and date for interview shall be communicated
separately via email / mobile.
Position: Research Associate
Eligibility: Post graduate in social science discipline (55% minimum) with NET /M.Phil. /
Ph.D. and 2 years research experience.
Remuneration per month: Rs. 47,000/-
Upper age limit: As per UGC norms
Dr Sunil Bhardwaj
(Project Director)
Mobile: 9622221041,7006184456
Email: sunil.tbsju@gmail.com
